models.notes: Superseded by gpt-5.6-sol/gpt-5.6-terra. Disabled rather than deleted so past benchmark history referencing this id still resolves. Its 30K TPM cap made it unreliable for large-book adaptation (see issue-27).

Replaces gpt-4o. Confirmed live via direct OpenAI API call: reasoning-family model, rejects non-default temperature (GrokChatClient self-heals by retrying without it). maxInputTokens=400,000 and max output=128,000 per published spec. Pricing is still an unverified placeholder copied from gpt-4o — update when a real source is available. One of three gpt-5.6 variants (sol/terra/luna) in this account; no plain gpt-5.6 exists.

Replaces gpt-4o alongside gpt-5.6-sol. Confirmed live via direct OpenAI API call: reasoning-family model, rejects non-default temperature (GrokChatClient self-heals by retrying without it). maxInputTokens is officially unpublished by OpenAI (unlike Sol's 400,000 and Luna's 1,050,000) — 128,000 kept here as a deliberately conservative placeholder floor, not a real spec; raise it if a real source turns up. Pricing is also an unverified placeholder copied from gpt-4o. One of three gpt-5.6 variants (sol/terra/luna) in this account; no plain gpt-5.6 exists.

Third gpt-5.6 variant alongside sol/terra, added to try to beat sol's benchmark lead. Confirmed live via direct OpenAI API call: reasoning-family model, rejects non-default temperature (GrokChatClient self-heals by retrying without it). maxInputTokens=1,050,000 per published spec (largest of the three variants). Pricing is an unverified placeholder copied from gpt-4o — update when a real source is available.
Ultra-fast low cost OpenAI classifier model.
OpenAI high-reasoning benchmark model.

Also uses videos/extensions for clip continue. Fresh text/image-to-video allows 1-15s; the new portion of a reference/continue call is tighter (often <=10s, not independently confirmed to the second — maxExtensionSeconds is a conservative estimate, not a documented exact figure). 1080p pricing (0.25/s) may actually belong to a separate 'Grok Imagine 1.5' variant not yet split out as its own catalog entry — base model 480p/720p rates (0.05/0.07) are confirmed against docs.x.ai.

Open-weights 13B DiT video generation model hosted on Fal.ai serverless GPUs. Billed as a flat ~$0.40/video (frame-count-based generation, not duration-based) — NOT per-second; a prior per-second rate here (0.005/s) underpriced a 5s clip by ~16x ($0.025 vs the real ~$0.40 flat fee). Single init/reference image only (true i2v) — not Grok-style multi-plate identity conditioning; attaching more than one is misleading. Deliberately no min/max/absMaxClipDurationSeconds: the real API parameter is num_frames (85 or 129) + fps, not seconds — forcing a seconds-shaped min/max onto a frame-count model would itself be a wrong approximation; now represented directly via shortClipFrameCount/longClipFrameCount (the model's real NumberofFramesEnum: 85 or 129, default 129) rather than a generic duration bound. numInferenceSteps default 30 confirmed against fal.ai/models/fal-ai/hunyuan-video/api.

Alibaba Wan 2.1 open-weights image-to-video model hosted on Fal.ai serverless GPUs. Billed as a flat fee per video (frame-count-based generation, not duration-based), not per-second — a prior per-second rate here (0.025/s) underpriced a 5s 720p clip by ~3x ($0.125 vs the real ~$0.40 flat fee). 1080p flat fee not independently documented; assumed equal to 720p pending confirmation. Duration is a narrow ~5-6s band (81-100 frames @ 5-24fps typical), NOT the generic 3-10s range — approximated here in seconds even though frames+fps is the more precise real parameter. Single init/reference image only (true i2v) — not Grok-style multi-plate identity conditioning; attaching more than one is misleading. numInferenceSteps default 30 confirmed against fal.ai/models/fal-ai/wan-i2v/api. Deliberately no shortClipFrameCount/longClipFrameCount: Wan's real num_frames (default 81, range 81-100 per fal-ai/wan-i2v) is a continuous range, not Hunyuan's discrete short/long enum, and FalVideoClient does not send an explicit num_frames override for Wan today — this entry stays duration-native via min/max/absMaxClipDurationSeconds above instead.

Wired via GeminiVideoClient (text/image-to-video only). Documented duration is exactly 4, 6, or 8 seconds (not an arbitrary range) — 1080p/4K surfaces often restrict to 8s only; no 480p support. Some surfaces document up to 3 multi-image 'ingredients' reference images, but GeminiVideoClient does not implement that conditioning path — it throws NotSupportedException rather than silently ignoring reference images, so maxReferenceImages is 0 here (fail loud) until ingredients support is actually built. Confirmed via Gemini video docs / AI Studio Veo / Cloud Veo 3.1 pages, not yet verified against a live account.
Primary portrait engine for photoreal / studio character plates. Grok Imagine multi-image edit hard cap is 3 references.
Grok Imagine multi-image edit hard cap is 3 references.
Wired via GeminiImageClient. Supports up to 14 reference images (documented soft max; older Flash image paths may be lower).
Open-source Flux.1 Dev model via Fal.ai serverless GPU (~$0.025/image).
Ultra-fast open-source Flux.1 Schnell model via Fal.ai (~$0.003/image).
Stage planning, cast scrub, screenplay helpers.

xAI's actual latest generation, newer than grok-4.5 despite the lower-looking version number (4.20 > 4.5 as sequential minor releases, not decimals) — discovered via direct xAI model-list API call, not previously in this catalog. Its own aliases tag it beta/experimental (grok-4.20-beta, grok-4.20-experimental-beta-...), so treat results with more caution than the established grok-4/grok-4.5. Confirmed live: accepts temperature normally, but REJECTS reasoning_effort outright ("does not support parameter reasoningEffort", camelCase/no-underscore in the error text — GrokChatClient's self-heal matches both spellings) — it appears to always reason without an exposed effort dial. context_length confirmed 1,000,000 via API; pricing is an unverified placeholder copied from grok-4 (xAI's own price fields use an internal unit not yet decoded to $/M).
Wired via AnthropicChatClient. maxOutputTokens=128000 confirmed via platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview (Claude Sonnet 5 max output: 128k tokens).

Anthropic's flagship, one tier above claude-sonnet-5, added to try to beat gpt-5.6-sol's benchmark lead. Wired via AnthropicChatClient. Confirmed live via direct Anthropic API call: rejects temperature entirely like sonnet-5 (self-healed); supports adaptive thinking + output_config.effort for reasoningEffort. maxInputTokens/pricing are unverified placeholders copied from claude-sonnet-5 — update when a real source is available. maxOutputTokens=128000 confirmed via platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview (Claude Opus 5 max output: 128k tokens).

Wired via GeminiChatClient. Supports Native Multimodal MP4 Video Review. Was gemini-2.5-pro, which Google retired for new API keys (404 "no longer available to new users") — GeminiChatClient was already silently falling back to gemini-2.5-flash on that 404, so this just makes the catalog match what was actually running.

Wired via GeminiChatClient. Reasoning/"thinking" model per Google's own model metadata (thinking: true) — same class as OpenAI's o-series; watch for similar quirks (temperature/param rejection, thinking tokens counting toward output budget). Pricing copied from gemini-2.5-flash as a placeholder — not verified against a real source, update when known.

First Gemini Pro-tier model in this catalog — every other Gemini entry so far is Flash-tier. Added to try to beat gpt-5.6-sol's benchmark lead. Wired via GeminiChatClient. Confirmed live via direct Google API call: thinking:true, inputTokenLimit 1,048,576, outputTokenLimit 65,536; thinkingConfig.thinkingLevel confirmed up to "high" (Gemini's ceiling — no "max"/"xhigh" tier exists). "-preview" tag means Google could change or retire this id without notice; pricing copied from gemini-3.6-flash as a placeholder, not verified against a real source.
GrokVisionClient: book-page OCR, cast-on-image classify, and multi-image frame review.

Wired for clip/frame review via MultiProviderVisionClient (OCR/cast-classify stay Grok-only). maxOutputTokens=128000 confirmed via platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview (Claude Sonnet 5 max output: 128k tokens).

Wired for clip/frame review (CompleteWithImagesAsync) via MultiProviderVisionClient (OCR/cast-classify stay Grok-only). Was gemini-2.5-pro, retired by Google for new API keys — see the Chat entry's note.

A different unofficial Suno reseller (docs.aimusicapi.ai). No documented duration control — generates a full track at whatever length Suno produces (typically ~2-4 min); the client-side mix step trims to scene length.
